facts.business: Arnold Holdings Limited is a non-deposit taking Base Layer NBFC registered with RBI, primarily engaged in providing inter-corporate loans, personal loans, loans against shares & securities, loans against properties, trade financing, bills discounting, and trading in shares & securities.
key_risks: Branding: Not a well-established brand among large NBFC players with access to larger financial resources
Accessibility: No branches, unable to explore business opportunities in other areas
Regulatory restrictions: Continuously evolving government regulations may impact operations
Uncertainty: Uncertain economic and political environment
Economic Downturn: Prolonged downturn can reduce financing needs due to shrinking business opportunities
Private Banks Competition: Private banks working on similar business models giving strong competition
Regulatory Changes: Potential tightening of NBFC regulations could significantly impact operational dynamics and increase compliance-related expenditures
facts.related_party_note: During the year, the Company disbursed a loan of ₹500.00 lakh to Allwin Securities Limited, which was fully repaid during the same year along with interest. As at 31 March 2026, loans outstanding to related parties aggregated to ₹195.05 lakh (excluding accrued interest), comprising ₹190.05 lakh due from Mr. Pawan Kumar Mallawat and ₹5.00 lakh due from Mr. Sandeep Mallawat, carried forward from preceding year.
